commands: case "$RECORD_SITE_URL" in https://www.fintekkers.org/*) ;; *) echo 'RECORD_SITE_URL must be a https://www.fintekkers.org/ page'; exit 1;; esac; [[ "$RECORD_ITEM" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ ]] || { echo 'RECORD_ITEM is not set to an item id'; exit 1; }; echo "target: $RECORD_ITEM on $RECORD_SITE_URL"

set -o pipefail; HORIZON_RECORDER_ENV=/etc/horizon/recorder.env node scripts/record-item.mjs "$RECORD_ITEM" --site "$RECORD_SITE_URL" --out "$HOME/recordings/solution/raw/3-work-item" 2>&1 | tee "$HOME/recordings/solution/raw/3-work-item/record.log" && grep -qx "closed: $RECORD_ITEM" "$HOME/recordings/solution/raw/3-work-item/record.log" && echo "RESULT closed: $RECORD_ITEM"
cd "$HOME/recordings/solution/raw/3-work-item" && ls -l "$RECORD_ITEM.mp4" timeline.json frames/before.png frames/after.png frames/card-before.png frames/card-after.png

node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os'),p=require('path');const d=p.join(os.homedir(),'recordings/solution/raw/3-work-item');const t=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,'timeline.json'),'utf8'));const log=fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,'record.log'),'utf8');const m=log.match(/\((\d+) timeline entries\)/);const f=t[0],l=t[t.length-1];const s=t.filter(e=>e.kind==='step'||e.kind==='card');console.log('first: '+f.kind+' | '+f.caption);console.log('last: '+l.kind+' | '+l.caption);console.log('steps: '+s.map(e=>e.step).join(' > '));console.log('entries: '+t.length+' log: '+(m?m[1]:'none'));const ok=f.kind==='before'&&l.kind==='after'&&f.caption.startsWith('Before: https://www.fintekkers.org/')&&f.caption.slice(8)===l.caption.slice(7)&&s.length>0&&m&&Number(m[1])===t.length;console.log(ok?'timeline OK':'timeline FAIL');process.exit(ok?0:1)"

d=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=nw=1:nk=1 "$HOME/recordings/solution/raw/3-work-item/$RECORD_ITEM.mp4") && echo "duration: $d" && awk -v d="$d" 'BEGIN{exit !(d>=10 && d<=55)}' && echo 'video OK'
psql -X -tAc "SELECT status FROM step_run WHERE item_id = '$RECORD_ITEM' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
